title: omopHeor Agent Guidelines & Architecture Instructions
text: Welcome omopHeor repository. omopHeor R package ecosystem Real-World Evidence (RWE) Health Economics Outcomes Research (HEOR) focused Healthcare Resource Utilization (HCRU) Cost-Effectiveness Analysis (CEA) OMOP CDM data.

title: omopHeor Agent Guidelines & Architecture Instructions
text: Agents developing functions modules omopHeor must align implementations 6-stage framework: Define target treatment, comparator, clinical outcome cohorts using standardized vocabularies. Enforce omopgenerics standards cohort table creation cohort naming (snake_case, <100 characters). Build unadjusted baseline tables enriched demographics. Evaluate entry timing cohort attrition. Extract raw unadjusted care utilization (hospitalizations, outpatient visits, ED visits, drug prescriptions) direct medical costs. Fit high-dimensional regularized logistic regression models based baseline clinical features. Provide modular helpers matching, trimming, weighting, SMD balance diagnostic plots. Aggregate longitudinal patient timelines discrete, mutually exclusive health states uniform time cycles. Compute state--state transition probability matrices pull state-specific cost distributions directly OMOP COST table. Provide wrappers exporters decision-analytic state-transition models microsimulations incorporating parametric uncertainty. Export standardized summaries plots Incremental Cost-Effectiveness Ratios (ICER), Net Monetary Benefit (NMB), Cost-Effectiveness Acceptability Curves (CEAC).

title: omopHeor Agent Guidelines & Architecture Instructions
text: Language: R (Target R >= 4.1). Pipes: Always use base R pipe |> instead %>%. Assignment: Always use <- assignment (never =). Functions & Arguments: Use lowerCamelCase (e.g. addInpatientHcru(), computeHospitalizationCohorts(), indexDate = "cohort_start_date"). Provide snake_case aliases backward compatibility needed. Database & Cohort Columns: Use snake_case table column names (e.g. cohort_start_date, inpatient_admissions, days_supply, total_paid). S3 Classes: Use snake_case prefixed hermes_ (e.g. hermes_study, hermes_hcru). Never modify core OMOP tables. Write temporary work tables designated result/scratch schemas. Rely omopgenerics accessors (cohortCount(), settings()). create custom extractors official OHDSI/DARWIN package methods exist. Place unit tests tests/testthat/. Ensure new logic test coverage using testthat. Adhere .github/CONTRIBUTING.md extras/PackageMaintenance.R. Run styler::style_dir() lintr::lint_package(".", linters = lintr::linters_with_defaults(lintr::object_name_linter(styles = "camelCase"))) committing.

title: Cohort Utilization & Cost Enrichment
text: Health Economics Outcomes Research (HEOR) Real-World Evidence (RWE), evaluating Healthcare Resource Utilization (HCRU) direct medical costs requires capturing granular patient encounters across multiple care settings (inpatient, outpatient, emergency, pharmacy, diagnostics, procedures, financial claims). Following DARWIN EU / OHDSI package ecosystem standards (CohortConstructor, PatientProfiles, CohortCharacteristics), omopHeor provides pipe-friendly, 3-layer architecture cohort construction, -database column enrichment, standardized reporting.

title: HCRU Extraction Logic
HCRU Extraction Logic
text: OMOP CDM v5.3+ stores costs polymorphic COST table cost_event_id references primary key domain table indicated cost_domain_id:
code: SELECT    c.person_id,   c.cost_domain_id,   c.cost_type_concept_id,   c.total_paid,   c.total_charge,   c.paid_by_payer,   c.paid_by_patient,   v.visit_concept_id,   v.visit_start_date,   v.visit_end_date FROM cdm.cost c JOIN cdm.visit_occurrence v    ON c.cost_event_id = v.visit_occurrence_id   AND c.cost_domain_id = 'Visit' WHERE c.person_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM study_cohort);

title: Introduction to HEOR for OMOP Users
text: compare apples apples across different diseases, health economists use standardized metrics: QALY (Quality-Adjusted Life-Year): measure disease burden, including quality quantity life lived. One QALY equates one year perfect health. ICER (Incremental Cost-Effectiveness Ratio): core output CEA. represents additional cost per additional unit health gained (usually per QALY). ICER=CostTarget−CostComparatorEffectTarget−EffectComparator ICER = \frac{Cost_{Target} - Cost_{Comparator}}{Effect_{Target} - Effect_{Comparator}} new drug costs $50,000 standard care provides 1 additional QALY, ICER $50,000/QALY. Payers “Willingness--Pay” (WTP) threshold (e.g., $100,000/QALY). ICER threshold, drug considered cost-effective.

title: The omopHeor Ecosystem: Modular Architecture & Package Suite
text: real-world HEOR workflows, analytical tasks often fall two distinct paradigms: Healthcare Resource Utilization & Direct Costing: Epidemiologists data scientists need enrich OMOP cohorts inpatient admissions, emergency care, outpatient visits, prescriptions, procedures, claims costs -database using lightweight dependencies. Health Economics Modeling & Decision Simulation: Health economists need causal propensity score matching, longitudinal health-state transitions, Markov microsimulations, Bayesian Cost-Effectiveness Analysis (CEA) using specialized statistical packages (Cyclops, BCEA, CohortMethod). Decoupling domains allows users install dependencies required specific workflow maintaining single, unified interface omopHeor metapackage.

title: The omopHeor Ecosystem: Modular Architecture & Package Suite
text: CohortUtilisation standalone, lightweight package designed extract quantify Healthcare Resource Utilization (HCRU) OMOP CDM databases without requiring economic modeling dependencies. implements 3-layer architecture aligned DARWIN EU standards (CohortConstructor, PatientProfiles, CohortCharacteristics): computeHospitalizationCohorts(): Collapses contiguous/overlapping inpatient stays derives 30-day readmissions. computeInfusionCohorts(): Identifies parenteral intravenous therapy episodes. addInpatients() / addHospitalizations(): Inpatient admissions, length stay (LOS), ICU utilization, 30d/90d readmissions, specialty breakdown. addEmergencyCare() / addEmergency(): Emergency encounters captured via visit concepts Emergency Medicine provider specialties. addOutpatientVisits(): Primary care (GP), specialist, outpatient visits. addVisits(): Composite multi-setting enricher covering Inpatient, Outpatient, Emergency care one call. addPrescriptions(): Medication fills, cumulative days supply, Proportion Days Covered (PDC). addProcedures(): Diagnostic measurements, laboratory tests, clinical procedures. summariseUtilization(): Aggregates metrics standardized summarised_result objects. tableUtilization(): Formats publication-ready tables gt, flextable, tibble. plotUtilization(): Renders ggplot2 visualizations utilization distributions.

title: The omopHeor Ecosystem: Modular Architecture & Package Suite
text: CohortEconomics core Health Economics Outcomes Research (HEOR) modeling package. implements complete 6-stage analytical pipeline cohort definition decision analysis: Stage 1: Cohort Generation & Initialization (init()): Sets target treatment, comparator, clinical outcome cohorts. Stage 2: Descriptive Baseline & HCRU Extraction (summarise_baseline(), extract_hcru()): Computes demographics, baseline characteristics, care utilization health-state tagging. Stage 3: Causal Propensity Score (PS) Adjustment (fit_ps(), adjust_ps(), assess_balance()): Fits regularized logistic regression via Cyclops perform caliper matching evaluate covariate balance (SMD). Stage 4: Trajectory Compilation & State-Cost Extraction (compile_trajectories()): Converts longitudinal patient timelines Markov health-state transition matrices state-specific cost distributions. Stage 5: Economic Simulation (simulate_economics()): Runs probabilistic sensitivity analysis (PSA) simulating lifetime costs Quality-Adjusted Life-Years (QALYs). Stage 6: Decision Analysis & Post-Processing (run_cea(), plot_ceac(), plot_plane(), table_summary()): Calculates Incremental Cost-Effectiveness Ratios (ICER) Net Monetary Benefit (NMB) via BCEA.

code: library(omopHeor) library(dplyr)  # 0. Connect to CDM (built-in synthetic mock database) cdm <- mockOmopHeor()  # 1. Enrich cohort with visits, prescriptions, and direct costs in-database cdm$study_enriched <- cdm$target_cohort |>   addVisits(     window = list(baseline = c(-365, -1), followup = c(0, 365)),     settings = c("inpatient", "outpatient", "emergency"),     stratifySpecialty = TRUE,     readmissions = TRUE   ) |>   addPrescriptions(     window = list(followup = c(0, 365)),     daysSupply = TRUE,     pdc = TRUE   ) |>   addCosts(     window = list(followup = c(0, 365)),     costField = "total_paid",     name = "study_enriched"   )  # 2. Summarise utilization and costs into standardised results util_summary <- summariseUtilization(cdm$study_enriched) cost_summary <- summariseCosts(cdm$study_enriched)  # 3. Format publication tables (GT, Flextable, or Tibble) tableUtilization(util_summary) tableCosts(cost_summary)

title: omopHeor 0.7.1
text: CohortUtilisation::addInpatients(): Integrated interval collapsing (cummax + gap <= 1 day) collapseOverlapping = TRUE (default), merging intra-hospital department transfers contiguous admissions discrete hospitalization episodes without double-counting LOS days generating false readmissions. CohortUtilisation::computeHospitalizationCohorts(): Added lifecycle guidance pointing users addInpatients() -database HCRU characterization.

title: omopHeor 0.7.0
text: CohortUtilisation::addOutpatientVisits(): Added countBy = c("days", "records") (default: "days") collapseOverlapping = TRUE count distinct calendar visit dates eliminate administrative duplicate record overestimation. CohortUtilisation::addEmergencyCare(): Collapses -day emergency encounters overlapping care spans default distinct emergency presentations. CohortUtilisation::addVisits(): Propagates countBy collapseOverlapping across Inpatient, Outpatient, Emergency care settings single call. CohortEconomics::extract_hcru(): Harmonized calculate distinct visit dates study$hcru$patient_summary study$hcru$outpatient keeping study$costs total_cost 100% exhaustive financial event level. Specialty-stratified deduplication: Outpatient visits calculate distinct dates per specialty independently maintaining distinct global outpatient visit day totals.

Acronym Expansion: Expanded domain acronyms first mention DESCRIPTION files (OMOP, CDM, HCRU, HEOR, CEA) wrapped software package names single quotes. Import Standardization: Fixed dbplyr, dplyr, rlang imports eliminate unused namespace NOTEs R CMD check. Canonical URLs: Updated repository website links canonical HTTPS without 301 redirects (https://www.iomed.health/, https://github.com/iomedhealth/hermes/issues).
